about.title: About Raqeem
about.subtitle: At Raqeem, we turn your children's photos into joyful, colorful memories. Every book is custom-designed so your child becomes the hero of their own adventure.
about.storyBody: Raqeem was born from a desire to create a tangible, meaningful gift that brings children away from digital screens and into an artistic adventure where they see themselves as the hero. Our team manually illustrates every character with care and prints on premium paper in Egypt.
about.valuesTitle: What Makes Raqeem Printed Books Special
about.v1Title: Tangible Physical Book — Not a Digital PDF
about.v1Body: We deliver a physically printed, spiral-bound coloring book with a laminated color cover and thick paper right to your home.
about.v2Body: Children's photos are used strictly to prepare your requested book and are never published publicly without separate, explicit guardian consent.
about.v3Body: Our team contacts you via WhatsApp or phone to review all details and confirm pricing and shipping before printing.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Child Photo Protection
privacy.subtitle: At Raqeem, we uphold strict privacy and security standards to protect your child's photos and family data.
privacy.s1Body: No child photo is uploaded or processed without explicit guardian consent on the request form authorizing photo processing solely to prepare the requested coloring book.
privacy.s2Body: Original uploaded photos are stored in a private storage bucket inaccessible to the public and accessed only by authorized staff via short-lived signed URLs.
privacy.s3Title: 3. No Public Display Without Separate Permission
privacy.s3Body: We never display or publish a child's photo in our portfolio or marketing pages without separately verified guardian publishing consent.
privacy.s4Body: Parents and guardians may request complete deletion of their child's photos and personal details at any time by contacting the Raqeem team.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Terms governing custom coloring book requests submitted through the Raqeem website.
terms.s1Body: Submitting a request on Raqeem is free and does not constitute an online payment or binding checkout. An order is confirmed only after our team contacts the guardian via WhatsApp or phone to confirm final details.
terms.s2Body: Book prices and quantity discounts (10% for 2 books, 20% for 3+ books) apply to the books subtotal only, excluding shipping. Shipping varies by Egyptian governorate and is confirmed with the customer.
terms.s3Body: Because each book is custom-illustrated and printed with the child's name and likeness, our team confirms specifications with the guardian prior to final printing.
